notes: Only invented fixtures and public model artifacts; no logs/state files or private source contents.
Sequential and alternating conditions are distinct; final latency claims use alternating trials.
All read comparisons use bit-identical SQLite inputs. Mutating cases restore source bytes and healthy logical state, not row IDs/timestamps.
Initial full baseline resource timing/allocation metrics are omitted because hooks retained mock call histories; deterministic counters are retained.
Final matched profiles use the same plain-function hooks; sampled RSS is not unique physical memory.
p95 is the observed maximum for these small sample counts.
